static_traits.name: Han Sikai
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a younger sibling
static_traits.social_status: 与同伴建立关系困难，常因身高not安而Withdrawal；家庭支持但难以向家人谈及not安
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病；此前not yet接受心理问题的治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度尚可；语气消极，常use灾难化与非黑即白的表述；思维以比较和Self-denial为主；因过度思考导致Sleep disturbed

basic_info.main_problem: 我持续感到自己not够好并希望自己更高，这影响了我的自尊和日常生活。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings have begun to affect my academic performance and my relationships with peers.
growth_experiences: 青少年时期开始因身高与同龄人比较而产生自卑感，社会压力与对更高个体的比较逐渐Reinforcement这种not安全感；在过去一年尤为加重，几乎每天在看到更高的人或被指出身高时都会被trigger，进而影响社交、自信与情绪。
原生家庭支持度较高（Living with parents and younger siblings），但来访者难以向家人谈论与身高相关的not安与羞耻，这种难以沟通的模式延续至现在的人际互动。

core_beliefs: Height determines my worth and how seriously I am taken
I will not succeed或快乐（因为身高）

special_situations.event: 在Social gatherings上看到许多人比自己高
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not够高，就without法与他人建立连接、会被看not起
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing活动、减少与同伴接触以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都在因为我的身高而评判我，我not如他们

special_situations.event: Someone mentions my height to my face or in jokes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦身高被指出，就证明我not值得被认真对待
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 保持沉默、尽量not谈论个人观点与感受

special_situations.event: Daily sees people taller than oneself on campus or in public places
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 身高决定成就与幸福，如果我not够高，我的人生就会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly compares and overthinks, trying to convince oneself or find proof
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的人生被毁了；I will never succeed或快乐

special_situations.event: When facing academic tasks, is distracted by height-related thoughts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not够高，同学not会接纳我，学习也have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced study effort, procrastinating on tasks

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认真对待、被接纳并拥有自我价值（not以身高为条件）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因身高被嘲笑或拒绝，最终一事without成、without法被爱
defense_goal: 通过保持距离与Avoids socializing来减少被评判的风险
Attributes difficulties to height to avoid facing deeper vulnerability and shame

object_relations.self_representation: 矮小且not被认真对待的被评判者/not够好的人
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、评判他人的他者（随时可能因为身高看not起我）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites him to examine the evidence, conduct reality testing, or challenge the belief that 'height determines everything'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者潜意识可能认为咨询师在negate自己的感受或not理解其处境
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以委婉但坚定的方式重复“身高才是关键”的理由，强调过去尝试都without效，用低沉语气减少情感暴露，避免深入讨论个体需求。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing plans to build relationships with others or enter social situations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向于将他人的负面评价归因于对方的意图，认为do not人会看not起自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用防御性的语气强调“他们会嘲笑我”，use假设性词汇（例如‘一定’、‘总是’），避免细化具体证据或例外情况。

manifestations: 在Social gatherings中感到自己格格not入并选择回避
Hard to build connections with peers, believes others will judge oneself because of height
Seeing the world through the belief that height determines life worth
在学习中产生“做什么都have not用”的想法

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 在社交场合认为do not人总在因身高评判自己
将互动中的not适全部归因于他人的负面意图

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复比较与Self-denial，认为“我not配被认真对待”
Overly cautious in interactions, reduces expression and contact

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 难以向家人讨论身高相关的not安，选择沉默
在社交场合Suppressing expression冲动，转而Withdrawal与自责

exception_events.target_problem: 在Social gatherings时，来访者通常会因身高自卑而撤退、难以与人交流，并在事后持续反刍。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在与not在意身高的同伴一起的某次相处中，来访者have not像往常那样Withdrawal，而是参与互动，感受到他人并not yet以身高评判自己，压力明显减轻。
exception_events.reason: not同支持：周围的人not把身高当作评价标准；not同情境：互动氛围安全、接纳，使其注意力从自我比较转向交流。

exception_events.target_problem: 在Being alone或学习前后，来访者通常会因反复思考身高问题而分心并影响学习投入。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在某次沉浸于自己喜欢的活动时，来访者have not像往常那样反复思考身高，而是保持专注，体验更为愉悦且干扰减少。
exception_events.reason: not同做法：将注意力投入具体任务，体验被活动吸引；not同情境：任务本身具有兴趣与挑战，减少自我关注。

positive_force: Willing to seek help and enter counseling
Able to be engaged and focused in liked activities
家庭支持存在（尽管难以谈及not安）
具备一定的学习能力与责任感（自述“有时觉得自己学习还not错”）
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent，常以“人生被毁了”等语句Self-denial
Strong tendencies of comparison and mind reading, excessively cares about others' views
Social avoidance and withdrawal，难以表达需求

target_behavior.behavior: 因身高自卑导致的Social avoidance
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and comparative cognitions that directly link height to individual worth, accompanied by mind reading and black-and-white thinking
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与羞耻的潜在威胁，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal alienation、Loneliness感加重，进一步降低自尊并影响学业与关系

target_behavior.behavior: 过度思考身高问题导致Sleep disturbed
antecedent: 夜间Being alone回想白天被trigger的经历
Before studying or resting, thinks of taller people or related comments
target_behavior.core_reason: 对not yet来的负面Anticipation与心理过滤，试图通过反复思考获得确定感
target_behavior.function: 试图控制not确定性与自我安抚（短期），但维持问题
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality、注意力与学业表现受损，负性情绪增加
